Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
Join Siemens Energy / Aeroderivative Gas Turbines Department as Industrial Cybersecurity Officer. This is a senior role, at the forefront of our business and with great growth potential to become a team leadership position, for the right candidate.This role will enhance the cybersecurity resilience of the Aeroderivative Gas Turbines (AGT) product portfolio, ensuring business continuity. As part of AGTs Product Lifecycles Service and New Unit team, the Industrial Cybersecurity Officer will help establish and drive the cybersecurity strategy across the entire product lifecycle. The position covers three core areas: Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance, Secure Product Lifecycle Management, and Technical Security Assurance. These pillars encompass developing strategic roadmaps, embedding security-by-design principles into development processes, and executing technical risk assessments and vulnerability management. How Youll Make an ImpactDevelop and implement the cybersecurity strategy, so that our products and services are robust against emerging threats, safeguarding business continuity and customer trust.Embed Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) into product development, reducing vulnerabilities and enhancing the overall security of our offerings.Lead Risk Management Initiatives through Threat & Risk Assessments (TRAs) ensuring that our products meet the highest security compliance standards.Build a network of cybersecurity experts and promote a culture of security awareness and best practices across the organization.Translate market trends and regulatory requirements into actionable insights and enable the AGT to stay ahead of the curve.What You BringTo excel in this role, you will bring a combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and strong interpersonal skills:A minimum of 8 years in Industrial/OT cybersecurity roles, with a track record in secure product development and risk management A Bachelors or Masters degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electrical/Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.The ability to influence cross-functional teams, foster collaboration, and effectively communicate complex cybersecurity concepts to diverse audiences.Strong analytical skills to assess risks and develop strategic roadmaps that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GICSP, and IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert/Specialist Familiarity with cybersecurity standards such as IEC 62443 and ISO 27001, with proven experience in implementing these standards within product organizationsExpertise in Secure Development Lifecycles (SDL/DevSecOps), Threat & Risk Assessments (TRA), and Vulnerability Management, and a solid understanding of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and OT architecture.Interested in connecting with the team and networking, with 3 days/week in the office and travel up to 10% of the timeAbout the teamThe Aero Derivative Gas Turbine (AGT) Product Life Cycle Team drives and governs key AGT cross product strategic initiatives including AGT product portfolio management, business development and technical services. We are a team of passionate and experienced individuals ready to take the AGT business to the next level. Our team culture embraces open dialog, freedom of opinion, diversity, and constantly challenging the status quo.You will work in a global and diverse team with an open approach that will support you and your development.Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company.
